needs_atom.missing: FIGHT with a targeted fighter (CR 701.12a): '• Target creature you control fights target creature you don't control.' Verb.FIGHT has only a target role (the foe); the fighter is the ability's battlefield source or the result register of the atom before it (verbs._fight_attacker), so a spell cannot make its first target the fighter: a draft with FIGHT over 'target creature you don't control' raises 'FIGHT has no attacker' in all four probe variants of the mode. Needed: a fighter role on FIGHT, a TARGET slot of its own ('target creature you control'), with CR 701.12b (if either target is illegal as it resolves, neither creature deals damage). Two DEAL_DAMAGE atoms would approximate it (the legal creature still deals its damage when the other target is gone), so no record. The rest maps: 'Choose one —' is Choose(count 1); the first mode is M21 Fierce Empath's SEARCH (basic land card, SUPERTYPE_EQ Basic + TYPE_EQ Land) to hand, REVEAL count 1, SHUFFLE.
